clips.title: The story
paras: Godrick Farsan is an undead warlock assistant located in the Undercity, serving alongside Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter. Despite being entirely blind, he says that he sees in a different way.

Situated amidst the summoning circles of the Magic Quarter, Godrick Farsan aids Master Carendin Halgar in guiding aspiring Forsaken warlocks. Though he lacks physical sight, Godrick says he can still see in a different way, without explaining the means. He tests practitioners seeking to bind greater demonic entities, dispatching them to gather pure hearts and essences needed for intricate summoning rituals.
